interest: Diplomatic log of Diet debates on China policy, 1937–39.
overview: Docket for 894.032 (1937–39) tracing the 71st to 75th Diets, mostly from Grew's reports on dissolution, elections and ministerial speeches on China.

subfiles.about: Reports the Japanese Government's dissolution of the Lower House and the scheduling of a general election for April 30, 1937.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports that Japan dissolved the Lower House on March 30, 1937 over the election bill, with elections set for April 30.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 101 from Grew on Dissolution of the Lower House
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet noting despatch reporting Japanese Diet proceedings from March 1 to March 16, 1937.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's despatch No. 2316 on Diet proceedings, March 1–16, 1937.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2316 from Grew on Diet Proceedings (March 1–16, 1937)
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Reports on proceedings of the Japanese Diet during the second half of March 1937 leading up to dissolution.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew submits Despatch No. 2339 covering the proceedings of the Japanese Diet from March 17 to March 31, 1937. The report covers legislative discussions and tensions between the government and parliament during the final weeks of the session preceding dissolution.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2339 from Grew on Diet Proceedings (March 17–31, 1937)
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Transmits an appraisal and political analysis of the Japanese Government's dissolution of the Diet.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew transmits Despatch No. 2350 providing an appraisal of the Japanese Government's dissolution of the Diet. The despatch evaluates the political ramifications of the cabinet's decision to dissolve the Lower House and the impending general election.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2350 from Grew on Appraisal of the Diet Dissolution
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Submits a preliminary report on the 71st Japanese Diet, including a list of legislative bills presented for approval.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew submits a preliminary report on the 71st session of the Imperial Diet convoked following the spring general election. The despatch provides an inventory of legislative bills submitted by the Government to both houses of parliament for consideration and approval.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2525 from Grew on Seventy-First Diet Preliminary Report
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet noting despatch reporting on the special session of the Diet convened July 23 to address the North China situation.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's despatch on the special Diet session of July 1937 on North China.
subfiles.title: Despatch from Grew on Special Diet Session and North China Situation
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet transmitting advance text of Foreign Minister Hirota's policy address before the 72nd Diet session.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to telegram No. 340 giving Hirota's address to the 72nd Diet.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 340 from Grew on Foreign Minister Hirota's Diet Address
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Reports the formal opening of the 72nd Diet session and transmits addresses by the Premier and cabinet members.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew submits Despatch No. 2594 detailing the opening proceedings of the extraordinary 72nd session of the Imperial Diet. The report includes official addresses delivered by Prime Minister Fumimaro Konoe and other members of the Cabinet outlining state policy during the expanding hostilities in China.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2594 from Grew on Opening of the Seventy-Second Diet
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Reports the official notice convoking the 73rd ordinary session of the Imperial Diet on December 24, 1937.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew reports on an imperial convocation notice published in the Official Gazette on November 10, 1937. The decree convoked both houses of the Japanese Diet to assemble for its 73rd ordinary session on December 24, 1937.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2662 from Grew on Convocation of the Seventy-Third Diet
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Reports the reconvening of the 73rd Diet and plans to telegraph ministerial addresses bearing on Japanese foreign policy.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports the Diet reconvened on January 22, 1938 and telegraphs excerpts of other ministers' speeches.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 45 from Grew on Reconvening of Diet and Ministerial Speeches
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Reports editorial commentary on Foreign Minister Hirota's speech attempting to divide the United States and Great Britain.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew reports on press editorial reactions to Foreign Minister Hirota's Diet speech of January 22, 1938. The commentary characterizes the address as an unsuccessful attempt by Japan to drive a diplomatic wedge between the United States and Great Britain.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 145 from Grew on Press Reaction to Hirota's Diet Speech
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Offers State Department Far Eastern Division commentary on phases of Foreign Minister Hirota's January 22 address before the Diet.
subfiles.summary: Joseph W. Ballantine of the State Department's Division of Far Eastern Affairs submits a memorandum analyzing Foreign Minister Kōki Hirota's January 22, 1938, address before the Imperial Diet. The memorandum provides departmental commentary on critical aspects of Japan's stated foreign policy and its international ramifications.
subfiles.title: Memorandum by Ballantine on Foreign Minister Hirota's Diet Address
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet noting report on Foreign Minister Hirota's Diet statements concerning belligerent rights and war declaration.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's telegram No. 79: Hirota said Japan had not claimed belligerent rights in China.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 79 from Grew on Belligerent Rights and Declaration of War
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet refuting press reports of alleged Diet statements regarding non-recognition of China and war declaration.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's telegram No. 80: no Diet statement matched press reports on non-recognition of China.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 80 from Grew on Non-Recognition of Chinese Government
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Analyzes January 22 Diet addresses by the Premier and Foreign Minister as evidence of Japan's resolve to alter East Asian conditions.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew submits Despatch No. 2769 analyzing the January 22 Diet speeches delivered by Prime Minister Konoe and Foreign Minister Hirota. Grew emphasizes that both addresses demonstrate the Japanese nation's hardening resolve to utilize ongoing hostilities to impose a permanent restructuring of political conditions across East Asia.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2769 from Grew on Premier and Foreign Minister Diet Addresses
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Transmits Embassy translations of principal ministerial replies to foreign affairs interpellations in the 73rd Diet.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew transmits Despatch No. 2763 containing free translations prepared by Embassy staff of key government replies to parliamentary interpellations on foreign policy. The interpellations, delivered during open sessions of the 73rd Diet following its January 22 reconvening, reflect intense legislative scrutiny of the Sino-Japanese conflict.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2763 from Grew on Interpellations on Foreign Affairs in the 73rd Diet
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet noting report on the formal opening of the 73rd Diet by Emperor Hirohito and budget distribution.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's despatch No. 2735 on the Emperor opening the 73rd Diet, December 26, 1937.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2735 from Grew on Formal Opening of the 73rd Diet by the Emperor
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Outlines five points from press reports of Foreign Minister Hirota's foreign policy statement before the Lower House Budget Committee.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew reports in Telegram No. 186 on five key foreign policy positions articulated by Foreign Minister Hirota during a meeting of the Lower House Budget Committee. The summary, based on press accounts, covers international legal questions, relations with China's provisional regimes, and foreign interests in war zones.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 186 from Grew on Hirota's Statement to Lower House Budget Committee
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet citing telegram quoting press reports of Diet statements by Konoe and Hirota on China policy.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to telegram No. 38 to Tokyo on reported Diet statements about non-recognition of China.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 38 to Tokyo on Diet Statements Concerning China Non-Recognition
subfiles.to: Joseph C. Grew (U.S. Embassy, Tokyo)

subfiles.about: Reviews the accomplishments of the 73rd Diet in passing government bills and encloses a Japan Times clipping.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew submits Despatch No. 2850 reviewing the legislative achievements of the 73rd Diet, which demonstrated strong parliamentary support for the Government's war mobilization agenda. The report enumerates the major bills enacted and encloses a press clipping from the Japan Times entitled 'Fruits of the 73rd Diet.'
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2850 from Grew on Accomplishments of the Seventy-Third Diet
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet noting report on parliamentary interpellations in both houses concerning China, foreign policy, and the budget.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's telegram No. 44 on Diet interpellations about China and the budget.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 44 from Grew on Diet Interpellations on China Conflict and Budget
subfiles.to: Department of State

subfiles.about: Reports on the 74th Diet session, summarizing enacted laws and enclosing a concluding statement by Prime Minister Hiranuma.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew submits Despatch No. 3808 reviewing the proceedings and legislative outputs of the 74th session of the Imperial Diet. The despatch contains a comprehensive résumé of laws enacted during the session and encloses a copy of the official statement issued by Prime Minister Kiichirō Hiranuma at the session's adjournment.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 3808 from Grew on Activities of the 74th Diet and Hiranuma Statement
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: Reports the publication of an Imperial Ordinance convoking the 75th session of the Imperial Diet on December 23, 1939.
subfiles.summary: Ambassador Grew informs the Department in Telegram No. 593 that an Imperial Ordinance was promulgated in Tokyo fixing December 23, 1939, as the convocation date for the 75th session of the Imperial Diet.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 593 from Grew on Convocation of the 75th Diet
subfiles.to: Department of State (Division of Far Eastern Affairs)
